description: This file defines a utility class 'JsonCollectors' that provides various collector implementations to facilitate JSON data accumulation and transformation tasks, such as converting JSON fields to objects, extracting keys and values into arrays, and collecting JSON objects and values.

classes.name: JsonCollectors
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods that return collectors for various JSON data accumulation patterns.

methods.name: fieldsToObject
methods.description: Returns a collector that accumulates JSON fields into a JsonObject.

methods.name: objectsToObject
methods.description: Returns a collector that combines JSON objects into a single JsonObject.

methods.name: fieldKeysToArray
methods.description: Returns a collector that extracts keys from JSON fields into a JsonArray.

methods.name: fieldValuesToArray
methods.description: Returns a collector that extracts values from JSON fields into a JsonArray.

methods.name: valuesToArray
methods.description: Returns a collector that accumulates JSON values into a JsonArray.
